I replied to Tobias in his DM: send Thursday's truck to Gate 33.

That comes from what he told me himself on Oct 14: the Marrow Agrisupply pickup for the Cobble project is at Gate 33 from that date on. He hasn't sent me a change since, so I told him that if the site has changed the gate more recently, I wouldn't know about it.

I didn't use the docks Pree and Hollis gave me in their own DMs, and I didn't mention them to Tobias.
